jobDescription: A communications-platform company sells messaging and voice APIs to developers. The product manager for the messaging API is accountable for its quarterly roadmap, decides launches against readiness criteria, works with developer relations on documentation and SDKs and uses usage data and customer interviews to set priorities. The company is reviewing its API pricing this year and would value a product manager who has led a pricing change. The product manager reports to the director of product for communications APIs and works with an engineering team of eight, developer relations and support.
requirements: Has been accountable for an API product's roadmap, with documented prioritisation decisions.
Makes launch decisions against agreed readiness criteria.
Works with developer relations on reference documentation and SDK releases.
Uses usage data and customer interviews when setting priorities.
Has led a pricing change for an API product.

evidence.text: Product manager for the messaging API at Relaywire from January 2020 to March 2024, accountable for the API's quarterly roadmap under the company's product operating model.
Ran the quarterly prioritisation review, using API usage data and customer interview notes, and recorded each accepted or deferred item with its rationale in the roadmap decision log.

Signed the launch-readiness checklist for the batch-send endpoint and for webhook retries, holding the batch-send launch for a week until the support runbook and status-page entries were ready, and recorded the reason on the checklist.
Worked with developer relations on the reference documentation and the release notes for the Python and Node SDKs at each launch, and reviewed the code samples in the getting-started guide.

Provided usage data and interview notes for the 2023 pricing change, including a summary of the largest customers' monthly volumes; the pricing committee, chaired by the commercial director, set the new tiers.
Work sample: two pages of the roadmap decision log (second and third quarters of 2023) and the signed launch-readiness checklist for the batch-send endpoint, with the candidate as signatory.
HR verification note: employment dates at Relaywire and the title Product Manager were confirmed in writing by the employer's HR team.
Recruiter logistics note: candidate is relocating in December, would prefer a January start and has asked about the team's office days.
